defs.def: a person who uses the services or advice of a professional person or organization 委托人；当事人；客户

ex.s: “I am the last original client of Frank Lloyd Wright, still living in the home he designed for me,” Reisley said, sitting in the bright open living room of the home designed by the famous architect.
ex.t: “我是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特最后一位健在的原始客户，至今仍住在他为我设计的房子里，”Reisley坐在由这位著名建筑师设计的明亮通透的客厅里说道。

ex.s: Finally, most clients wanted paintings that were beautiful and interesting to look at.
ex.t: 最后，大多数客户都希望看到漂亮又有趣的画作。

defs.def: a computer that is linked to a server （连接在服务器上的）客户机

ex.s: A large number of clients have / has been attracted to it.
ex.t: 许多客户机都被它所吸引。

chunks.cn: 坦率的的原来的委托人
